content.short: OnChainGM lets users send a daily on-chain GM and deploy contracts across 60+ networks.
content.description: OnChainGM turns saying good morning into an on-chain habit: users send a daily GM transaction or deploy a simple contract on dozens of networks, building streaks, badges and a place on a leaderboard with a monthly USDC reward pool. It also offers a bridge and a faucet. Unichain is among the networks listed on its site.
content.meta: OnChainGM is a daily on-chain GM and deploy ritual across 60+ networks, including Unichain.
